The monic quadratic polynomial with integer coefficients having $ \sqrt{13} - 3 $ as a root is found by eliminating the radical. Let $ \alpha = \sqrt{13} - 3 $. Then $ \alpha + 3 = \sqrt{13} $, squaring gives $ (\alpha + 3)^2 = 13 $, expanding yields $ \alpha^2 + 6\alpha + 9 = 13 $, simplifying to $ \alpha^2 + 6\alpha - 4 = 0 $. Thus, the polynomial is $ x^2 + 6x - 4 $.
